title: ci-cd-rollback-breadcrumbs-notes-5
body:
Quick breadcrumbs / notes to self from the canary rollback on 2026-03-25 (morning):

- Summary: canary deploy of inference-api image inference-api:2026.03.25-rc2 (git 3a7f2d1) started 2026-03-25T07:55Z. At ~08:12Z canaries started returning 500 / model-load-timeout and high tail latency. Canary weight was 10%. Auto-promote not enabled but CI pipeline attempted health checks and flagged failure.

- What I saw in logs:
  * inference-api (pod inference-api-rc2-6f8c) logs: "ERROR model_loader.cpp:142 ModelLoadTimeout: failed to load model xg-large in 30s" repeated.
  * Upstream errors: 502/504 on edge LB for streamed responses, spikes in memory pressure on host i-0a1b2c3d.
  * Datadog traces show KV cache mismatch warnings right before timeout. No obvious OOM (no OOMKilled).

- Commands I ran (chronological):
  1) kubectl -n prod logs deployment/inference-api -c inference-api --since=15m > /tmp/inf-canary-logs.txt
 2) kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=inference-api -o wide
 3) curl -s -D - -o /dev/null https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health | sed -n '1p'
 4) kubectl rollout history deployment/inference-api -n prod  # check revisions
 5) helm status inference-api -n prod  # chart v3.2.1
 6) # tried a quick rollback: helm rollback inference-api 6 -n prod  -> rollout started but some pods still hit the failing image due to imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent on node cache
 7) kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-api --to-revision=5 -n prod  (rolled back to stable 2026-03-18 build)
 8) curl tests against a pinned pod: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' https://pod-ip:8080/v1/predict -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' -> 200 OK after rollback

- Observations / hypotheses:
  * RC2 introduced a subtle model init change (lazy kv cache prefetch) that times out on hosts with older GPU drivers. Some nodes still had cached old image and inconsistent nvml driver versions.
  * Canary failure surfaced because model load path is CPU+GPU dependent and our smoke tests in CI didn't simulate long cold-starts.
  * Image tag naming mismatch: some infra scripts were caching latest-snapshot and overriding intended tag (GH ACTIONS job used :latest in one manifest).

- Immediate remediation we did:
  1) Rolled back to revision 5 (image inference-api:2026.03.18-stable). Verified 200s and normal latency.
  2) Marked the rc2 build as skippable in the releases board and revoked auto-promote.
  3) Pinned problematic nodes for driver upgrade in SRE runbook.

- Follow-ups / TODOs:
  * Postmortem (owner: @Maya Chen) - link to JIRA OPS-1426. Need timeline, root cause, CLMs.
  * Add a cold-start load test to CI that exercises model loading for 30s+ (simulate cold KV cache).
  * Ensure manifests in buildkite and helm use immutable tags (no :latest). Audit release scripts.
  * Add a pre-deploy check for driver compatibility (compare GPU driver version matrix) as part of canary gating.
  * Make rollback checklist clearer in runbook: prefer kubectl rollout undo to helm rollback for faster revert; note caveat about imagePullPolicy.
  * Create alert that triggers on repeated ModelLoadTimeout errors (SLO gap).

- Handy commands to keep (short):
  * kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference-api --to-revision=5
  * helm rollback inference-api <rev> -n prod
  * kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=inference-api -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}{"\t"}{.status.containerStatuses[0].image}{"\n"}{end}'
  * docker pull ghcr.io/redwood/inference-api:2026.03.18-stable && docker inspect --format '{{.Config.Image}}' ghcr.io/redwood/inference-api:2026.03.18-stable

- Notes to self: keep this file short, link final postmortem and clean up logs. Call SRE for driver rolling upgrade window (low traffic). Notify customers with affected SLAs after postmortem drafted.

- Raw snippets saved: 3a7f2d1 (rc2), 9b4e6c0 (stable). Buildkite job: https://buildkite.com/redwood/inference-api/builds/789

(End of scratchpad)
